sample_identity.selection_kind: purposive metadata-selected development sample; not blind

parent_identity_note: parent_datasets versions are actual eval/VERSION values; the 30-case sample has its own manifest SHA and does not create or replace an eval VERSION. Parent populations are 48+528+209=785; only ten per member were measured here.
measurement_note: Nine exact records from R65_targeted_9 plus 81 fresh records. These are not 90 fresh measurements from one batch. Every selected method/case has one measurement. Original targeted-nine report remains separate.
params_note: namespace is retained timing-cache protocol identity from the targeted-nine measurements; it is not a claim that execution scopes are identical.

four_sha_identity.cache_key_formula: SHA256 compact sort-key JSON of method_id, case_id, input_sha256, binary_sha256, framework_sha256, params_sha256

primary_formula: 0 when VAL<=0 or BASE<=0, else clamp(10*(1-VAL/BASE),0,10); uncapped sum of ten cases for each member; equal mean of three member sums
primary_score_note: No division by ten and no member 50-point cap. Each member sum has maximum 100 for ten cases; the three sums have equal weight. This is a partial development-sample score, not a complete-dataset competition rank.

quantile_definitions.ordinary_median: For n=30, arithmetic mean of the 15th and 16th sorted observations (1-based).
quantile_definitions.p50_nearest_rank: Sorted observation ceil(0.50*n); for n=30 this is position 15.
quantile_definitions.p90_nearest_rank: Sorted observation ceil(0.90*n); for n=30 this is position 27.
quantile_definitions.p95_nearest_rank: Sorted observation ceil(0.95*n); for n=30 this is position 29.
quantile_definitions.worker_source_p50: Source JSON explicitly used nearest-rank P50; source Markdown generic P50 labels also contained nearest-rank values. Both original nearest-rank P50 and ordinary median are retained here.

timing_note: Formal D is unchanged official internal chrono callback duration in microseconds. GNU CPU, elapsed and parent process wall are different measurements; diagnostic-build timing is not formal D. Rounded GNU 0.00 seconds is not proof of zero duration. One repeat cannot establish D stability or the cause of a difference.
limitations: Purposive 30-case partial sample, one repeat; cannot establish full-dataset or official competition ranking.
edges_all_empty cost is pure formal D (IO=0, Miss=0): 1.44 vs 0.68 microseconds. Single-run sub-microsecond difference cannot establish stable regression or its cause.
R65 retains 7/30 cost>Naive and 20/30 D>Naive; clipped per-case scores hide cost tails.
Formal D is the official internal chrono policy duration, distinct from GNU process CPU, elapsed, parent wall, and diagnostic build timing.
No new measurements or original report edits were made.
raw_note: stdout files preserve original bytes. stderr removes only the one machine-specific Command being timed path/command line, preserving all remaining bytes. Original/public SHA256 are separate. Original result JSON is represented by SHA256, without machine paths, process identifiers, or execution-session records.
per_case_csv_note: Exact original per_case.csv bytes; method labels, reused flags and failures/status retained.
